 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 participant P as Host owner
 participant I as Container init
 participant W as Workload
 participant H as Health probe
 P->>I: Start with configuration and three pipes
 I-->>P: FD 4, byte 1: signal handlers installed
 P->>P: Attach cgroup and configure network
 P->>I: FD 3: release start gate
 I->>I: Mount proc and pivot root
 I->>W: Start workload process group
 I-->>P: FD 4, byte 2: rootfs and workload ready
 P->>P: Save running state and init identity
 loop Interval while workload runs
 I->>H: Start one probe inside container
 H-->>I: Exit status or timeout
 I-->>P: FD 5: health snapshot
 P->>P: Persist health result
 end
 P->>I: Forward stop signal
 I->>H: Stop active probe
 I->>W: Forward signal to workload group
 W-->>I: Workload exits
 I-->>P: Exit with workload status
 P->>P: Cleanup, then decide whether to restart",
 "config": null,
 "version": "12"
